_comment: The full-page error and empty states. Figma models these as `noti-error` (15170:101685) — a component set, not artwork. It composes three things the library already has: a 280px illustration from the logo set, a heading and body, and the sticky action bar. Colours are borrowed from `colors/home`, so they are authored here against the semantic layer.

_verified_from.scope: all 4 variants, depth-4 walk of type=a-lot-of-users, plus the bound text styles
_verified_from.result: 390 wide with 16 of side padding and a 24 gap. A 280px illustration, then a text block with a 16 gap, then `bottom-action-bar2`. Title is `typography/display/xl-semb` (20/36 Semibold) in `home-fg-red`; body is `typography/body/m-reg` (14/22 Regular) in `home-fg-dark`. Both centred. The action bar holds a 326x44 primary button and a hidden tertiary one.
_verified_from.composition: Every part already existed: the three illustrations are in the logo manifest (`gp-jidrit-lot-of-users`, `gp-jidrit-error-occurred`, `gp-jidrit-system-down`) and `bottom-action-bar2` is what the library calls ActionBar. Nothing new had to be drawn — it is an arrangement, which is why it belongs with the components and not with the assets.

_source.illustration-size: 280, the size the instance is placed at. The marks themselves are 80x80 components; Figma scales them 3.5x here.
_source.colours: `colors/home/home-fg-red` and `home-fg-dark`, which resolve to primary.default and secondary.default. There is no `colors/error-state` group.

_figma_gaps.internet-error-reuses-an-illustration: `type=internet error` shows `gp-jidrit-system-down`, the same mark as `type=system-down`. Either it needs its own artwork or the two states are the same picture on purpose.
_figma_gaps.shorter-variant: `internet error` is 384 tall where the other three are 476. The content is the only difference, so the component hugs rather than pinning a height — but it is worth a designer confirming that is intended.
_figma_gaps.no-colour-group: There is no `colors/error-state` group; the set borrows `colors/home`.

_figma_icons._comment: The icons Figma instantiates for this component, read 2026-08-20 by walking the instance tree and keeping every main component whose parent set is `icons`. An icon Figma hides by default belongs in `icons` only when this component implements the state that reveals it; otherwise it is recorded under _figma_gaps instead, so the gate is not asking for a feature nobody built.

nodes.note: This component draws no icon at all in Figma. Recorded so that one appearing later has to be justified rather than slipping in.
